one_liner: PitchBook has a REST API (PB-Token API key) for private market data, but access requires a request to the Direct Data team and a paid contract; a vendor-run Premium Connector (MCP-based, SSO) exists only for licensed users via enterprise AI partners.
auth_notes: Static key sent as 'Authorization: PB-Token {API_KEY}', provisioned by PitchBook's team after access is enabled. The Premium Connector (MCP) authenticates via SSO for licensed users, not a public developer OAuth flow.
access_notes: API access starts by sending a request to the Direct Data team (or via Plugins & Apps in the platform for existing clients). A third-party page describes it as a paid, contract-gated add-on with no self-serve dashboard. The official PitchBook page itself does not state pricing.
blocker_notes: No self-serve credentials; must contact PitchBook's Direct Data team and obtain a contract. Endpoint list lives in a separate Highspot document not provided, so breadth is unverified. The MCP URL could not be verified from the pages.

evidence.quote: To start your API connection, you will need to send a request directly to our Direct Data team
Access to the PitchBook API is a paid, contract-gated add-on and is not available via a self-serve dashboard.
PitchBook authenticates requests using a static API key passed in the Authorization header with the format 'PB-Token {API_KEY}'.
The PitchBook API is a RESTful implementation that most HTTP clients can easily access in your chosen language or via a web browser.
AI partners connect securely to PitchBook’s Premium Connector (built on MCP server technology) directly through the partner’s site.
Only licensed PitchBook users can access the connector.
